# Steam Community

> > Steam Community is Valve Corporation's social platform for gamers to share user-generated content, connect with players, and access Steam Workshop features.

Steam Community serves as the social hub for Steam users, providing access to game-specific communities, user-generated Workshop content, discussion forums, and player profiles. The platform enables content creators and players to share mods, guides, artwork, and other community contributions for thousands of games.

- Steam Workshop
- S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
